aliases: Fire Thunder Divine Lord's true inheritance

summary.text: Fire Thunder true inheritance is the rank eight legacy of Fire Thunder Divine Lord. It lies hidden in the fire thunder river segment of red dragon river in Southern Border until the qi tides unveil it.

claims.text: Fire Thunder Divine Lord is a rank eight lone cultivator from Western Desert who cultivates fire path primarily and lightning path secondarily. After Western Desert super forces chase him, he reaches the fire thunder river segment of red dragon river in Southern Border with injuries that cannot heal, and before dying he makes arrangements that gradually turn the segment into the fire thunder river segment. His methods stay close to nature, so Ba clan and Xia clan at that boundary take the change as natural, and because the segment produces fire path and lightning path Gu worms but never Immortal Gu, they pay it little attention. The rank eight true inheritance is quite high quality and draws almost all of Southern Border’s super clans to compete, until only Wu clan, Ba clan, and Xia clan remain.

Wu Yong brings a Western Desert Gu Master, Zhong Yi, as Fire Thunder Divine Lord’s bloodline inheritor, arguing the true inheritance in the river belongs to him, and after defeating Ba De and Xia Zhao he retrieves Fire Thunder true inheritance from the river bottom with Zhong Yi. Zhong Yi kneels and requests to join Wu clan; Wu Yong agrees and treats him as a Gu Immortal seed with ample talent. Wu clan itself does not cultivate fire path or lightning path, so a rank eight fire thunder true inheritance is not especially significant to the clan.
Zhong Yi stands among Wu clan’s selected Gu Immortal seeds as the inheritor.
Among roughly fifty Gu Masters gathered before Wu Yong for immortal ascension support, Zhong Yi is named as the Western Desert Gu Master who has inherited Fire Thunder true inheritance.

Location.text: fire thunder river segment, red dragon river, Southern Border
